item: Qualification per-pass budgets follow the hardware (no fixed ceiling, the settings are a floor) and a candidate's read is bounded to its newest articles, sized from available memory (R95)
key_paths: src/catalog/qualification.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/scheduler/settings.py; src/analytics/source_quality.py; src/analytics/source_audit.py; src/api/source_management.py; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; tests/test_qualification_below_floor.py
summary: Follow-up to #1224 on the coordinator's relay of the maintainer's no-fixed-caps preference. adaptive_pass_budgets: slots = min(6 per core, available MB / 100), new = at least 5, re-checks = new/2 and at least 2, no ceiling, never below the setting, 0 stays 0, unreadable machine unchanged; qualification_budget_auto (default on) switches it. collect_article_stats(per_source_recent) + sq_source_to_articles bound each candidate to its newest N articles (N from candidate_history_cap: available memory, at least 2,000); the pass result carries history_cap and history_capped.
